card.name: Right before a word starting with e
card.fires_on: A word or piece just before a continuation that begins with the letter e, such as re|evaluate, vis|co|elastic and benzodiaz|epines. It also fires on some spaces or quotes before a word beginning with E.

card.writes: It promotes tokens that start with E and suppresses tokens that start with M, so it predicts that the next piece begins with e.
card.plain: It lights up when the next piece of a word is likely to start with the letter e, as in re-evaluate or viscoelastic.
